title: Thomas Edison's Work
text:
Thomas Edison was an inventor from the United States. He worked in a large laboratory in New Jersey. He created many useful things, such as the light bulb. People still use light bulbs every day.

Edison was not always successful. He tested thousands of materials before he found a good one for the light bulb. He said that he did not fail, but found many ways that did not work. His ideas changed the way people live.

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison fue un inventor de Estados Unidos. Trabajaba en un gran laboratorio en Nueva Jersey. Creó muchas cosas útiles, como la bombilla. Todavía usamos bombillas todos los días.

Edison no siempre tuvo éxito. Probó miles de materiales antes de encontrar uno bueno para la bombilla. Dijo que no había fracasado, sino que había encontrado muchas formas que no funcionaban. Sus ideas cambiaron la forma en que vive la gente.
